text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The promised Derby. Putting her whole 
heart and soul into it, Sakura Chiyono O 
reached victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having watched over it all, Maruzensky 
smiled, ready to fulfill her "final 
promise."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Competing with her rivals led to Sakura 
Chiyono O's growth and gave her new 
strength. Yet, before she can continue 
running alongside them—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, Mejiro Ardan collapsed. Due to 
the continuous strain she had put on her 
legs, they had become fragile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her rival was about to walk away from the 
racing world. However, Sakura Chiyono O 
swore that as her rival, she would 
definitely keep her from leaving.
